name: ops-toolkit
description: Six small browser tools for automation work. No build step, no dependencies.

scripts.test: node -e "const{TOOLS}=require('./tools.js');let f=0;for(const t of TOOLS){try{const r=t.run(t.sample);if(!r||!r.html)throw new Error('no output');console.log('PASS '+t.name)}catch(e){console.log('FAIL '+t.name+': '+e.message);f++}}process.exit(f)"
